goal: Make accepted work easy to find and safely reuse without flattening its provenance or limits.
acceptance: The next worker can find the full artifact by reference.
A changed source/hash invalidates the old exact-context reuse claim.
Superseded, private, proposed and accepted records remain distinguishable.
prompt: Create a compact handoff from these accepted artifacts. Include hashes, source dates, uncertainties and the next action; omit unrelated material and mark superseded conclusions.
